<thought>We need a template that describes the intramolecular Michael cyclization of a chalcone to a flavanone. The flavanone product can be represented by the SMILES “O=C1CC(c2ccccc2)Oc2ccccc12”. Using this SMILES, we search the template catalog for templates that form an ether oxygen and create C‑C and C‑O bonds (6‑6 and 6‑8) while breaking a C‑O bond (6‑8). This should return the appropriate template and its mapped reaction.</thought>
<action>search_template_catalog_by_criteria</action>
<action_input>{
    "molecule_smiles": "O=C1CC(c2ccccc2)Oc2ccccc12",
    "functional_groups_formed": ["ether oxygens"],
    "bonds_formed": ["6-6", "6-8"],
    "bonds_broken": ["6-8"],
    "limit": 10
}
</action_input>
